description: This file implements event handling for the Wesnoth game, including event dispatching, focus management, and input processing using SDL.

classes.name: resize_lock
classes.description: RAII class to temporarily disallow window resizing.

classes.name: context
classes.description: Stores a list of event handlers and manages focus cycling.

classes.name: event_context
classes.description: Manages stack of event handler contexts, especially for modal dialogs.

classes.name: handler
classes.description: Base class for objects that handle events.

methods.name: resize_lock()
methods.description: Constructor that increments disallow_resize to prevent window resize.

methods.name: ~resize_lock()
methods.description: Destructor that decrements disallow_resize.

methods.name: context()
methods.description: Constructor initializing focused_handler to -1.

methods.name: add_handler(handler* ptr)
methods.description: Adds a handler to the context.

methods.name: delete_handler_index(size_t handler)
methods.description: Removes handler at specified index, adjusts focus accordingly.

methods.name: remove_handler(handler* ptr)
methods.description: Removes a handler from the context, returns success status.

methods.name: cycle_focus()
methods.description: Cycles focus to the next handler requiring event focus.

methods.name: set_focus(const handler* ptr)
methods.description: Sets focus to the specified handler if it requires event focus.

methods.name: event_context(bool create)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new event context stack if specified.

methods.name: ~event_context()
methods.description: Destructor that pops the event context stack if created.

methods.name: handler()
methods.description: Constructor enabling Unicode input and adding handler to current context.

methods.name: ~handler()
methods.description: Destructor removing handler from context and restoring Unicode state.

methods.name: focus_handler(const handler* ptr)
methods.description: Sets focus to the specified handler.

methods.name: cycle_focus()
methods.description: Cycles focus among handlers.

methods.name: has_focus(const handler* ptr)
methods.description: Checks if the handler currently has focus.

methods.name: pump()
methods.description: Processes SDL events, manages focus, and handles window resize and input events.

methods.name: raise_process_event()
methods.description: Calls process_event() on all handlers in current context.

methods.name: raise_draw_event()
methods.description: Calls draw() on all handlers in current context.

methods.name: raise_volatile_draw_event()
methods.description: Calls volatile_draw() on all handlers.

methods.name: raise_volatile_undraw_event()
methods.description: Calls volatile_undraw() on all handlers.

methods.name: raise_help_string_event(int mousex, int mousey)
methods.description: Calls process_help_string() on all handlers with mouse position.
